_purpose: LNES-60 Phase 1 architecture freeze manifest. Sealed before holdout authoring begins. No changes to the frozen decision-logic files below are permitted after this point, regardless of holdout results.
_scope_note: Frozen scope is the DECISION-LOGIC engine only (the 7 files below) -- matching LNES-59's precedent of freezing state_consistency_gate_v2.py/deterministic_extraction.py while allowing execution/authoring tooling to keep evolving after freeze. lnes60/synthetic_generator.py is holdout-AUTHORING tooling, not decision logic, and is explicitly NOT frozen -- it is reused (with a fresh case-ID prefix and aircraft-ID offset parameter) to author the post-freeze holdout, exactly as LNES-59's explode_prompts.py/execution-ledger tooling was built after that project's own freeze without violating it.

not_frozen_reused_for_holdout_authoring.lnes60/synthetic_generator.py: parameterized post-freeze (prefix/aircraft_offset args added, additive only, dev-case behavior unchanged) so it can author the holdout with a guaranteed-disjoint fresh ID space -- see LNES60_HOLDOUT_MANIFEST.json for the holdout-authoring commit

defects_found_and_fixed.summary: SENSOR_DEGRADED misclassification from continuous measurement uncertainty conflated with discrete sensor health
Ground-truth specification error in a newly-authored test (config-epoch staleness), caught against already-frozen KTX test matrix class 14

known_limitations: Convergence engine evaluates one (aircraft, component, predicate) query at a time; multi-predicate release aggregation is exercised only at release_policy.py, not inside the convergence engine itself.

SENSOR_CONFLICT resolution requires at least 2 currently-admissible witnesses reporting different string values for the same predicate -- numeric near-duplicate disagreement (e.g. 4.9% vs 5.0% elongation) is not distinguished from an exact-match agreement; no tolerance-band comparison is implemented for numeric witness values in Phase 1.

Configuration epoch resolution (temporal_resolver.resolve_configuration_epoch) assumes epoch-changing events are correctly and completely recorded; a missing epoch-changing event record is indistinguishable from 'no epoch change occurred' -- this is a known gap consistent with the general principle that the engine can only reason over evidence that was actually committed.

The witness_validator's admissibility check order is fixed (aircraft/component binding, scope, signature, replay, calibration, freshness, health) -- for a witness failing multiple properties simultaneously, only the first-checked failure is reported as the reason, per a documented priority order, not because the other failures don't exist.

No real sensor hardware, calibration system, or aircraft was involved in producing this manifest -- see LNES60_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md and the witness envelope type discipline (SIMULATED_WITNESS only).
